question_text: A design contest stores entrant names in names and corresponding judge scores in scores. Each row has at least 3 numeric scores. Construct Python function final_scores(names, scores) returning (name, adjusted_mean) pairs. For each row remove exactly one occurrence of its largest and one of its smallest score before averaging. Use explicit loops to calculate totals/extrema rather than sum, min, max or sorting. Assume names and scores have equal length.
adaptation_rationale: Preserve nested traversal/extrema/mean challenge in Python; makes conditions/data domain explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
